#!/bin/bash
#
# Converted LSF job specification
#
### -- set the job Name AND the job array --
#SBATCH --job-name=shiftNMF_urine
#SBATCH --array=1-15
### –- specify queue --
#SBATCH --partition=hpc
### -- ask for number of cores (default: 1) --
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
### -- set walltime limit: hh:mm --
#SBATCH --time=48:00:00
### -- specify that we need 30GB of memory --
#SBATCH --mem=30G
### -- set the email address --
# please uncomment the following line and put in your e-mail address,
# if you want to receive e-mail notifications on a non-default address
##SBATCH --mail-user=your_email_address
### -- send notification at start --
##SBATCH --mail-type=BEGIN
### -- send notification at completion--
#SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL
### -- Specify the output and error file. %A is the job-id %a is the job-array index --
#SBATCH --output=Output.out
#SBATCH --error=./error/Output_%A_%a.err

# here follow the commands you want to execute
# Program_name_and_options
source test-env/bin/activate

MODEL="shiftNMF"
DATASET="urine"

python hpc_lr_test.py $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID $MODEL $DATASET >  ./output/out_${DATASET}+${MODEL}+${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}.out

reasons: The `--output` directive specifies a single static filename 'Output.out' for a job array of 15 tasks. All tasks will attempt to write to the same file, causing output to be overwritten or interleaved.
issues: The shell redirection `> ./output/out_${...}.out` in the script's command line overrides the `#SBATCH --output` directive for that specific command. It is best practice to handle all standard output redirection via the SBATCH directive (e.g., `#SBATCH --output=./output/out_%A_%a.out`) to avoid confusion and ensure all stdout is captured consistently.
The path specified in `--error=./error/Output_%A_%a.err` requires the directory 'error' to exist prior to job execution. The job may fail if Slurm cannot create the error file.

There are conflicting `--mail-type` directives. One (`##SBATCH --mail-type=BEGIN`) is commented out while `#SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL` is active. This is syntactically valid, but may not reflect the user's full intent for notifications.

#!/bin/sh
# embedded options to bsub - start with #BSUB
### -- set the job Name AND the job array --
#BSUB -J shiftNMF_urine[1-15]
### –- specify queue -- 
#BSUB -q hpc 
### -- ask for number of cores (default: 1) --
#BSUB -n 1
### -- set walltime limit: hh:mm --
#BSUB -W 48:00 
### -- specify that we need 4GB of memory per core/slot -- 
#BSUB -R "rusage[mem=30GB]"
### -- set the email address --
# please uncomment the following line and put in your e-mail address,
# if you want to receive e-mail notifications on a non-default address
##BSUB -u your_email_address
### -- send notification at start --
###BSUB -B
### -- send notification at completion--
#BSUB -N
### -- Specify the output and error file. %J is the job-id %I is the job-array index --
### -- -o and -e mean append, -oo and -eo mean overwrite -- 
#BSUB -o Output.out
#BSUB -e ./error/Output_%J_%I.err 
# here follow the commands you want to execute 
# Program_name_and_options
source test-env/bin/activate

MODEL="shiftNMF"
DATASET="urine"

python hpc_lr_test.py $LSB_JOBINDEX $MODEL $DATASET >  ./output/out_$DATASET+$MODEL+$LSB_JOBINDEX.out
